semantics.BLOCKED_JF02_HISTORY_NETWORK_TIMEOUT: A timeout is found in the JFException cause chain or message; do not classify as empty market interval.
semantics.BLOCKED_JF02_HISTORY_LOAD_FAILURE: Synchronous getTicks throws JFException without timeout evidence.
semantics.BLOCKED_JF02_HISTORY_RUNTIME_FAILURE: Unexpected runtime failure while processing the synchronous history response.

empty_response_semantics: Only a successful synchronous getTicks return with an empty List<ITick>; no transport failure claim.
